tasks.name: Plan, measure and report discipline deliverables
tasks.description: Keep the discipline deliverables list, measure progress by rules of credit, and report holds and change impacts to project controls.

consumes.use: deliverable numbers, titles and register status
planned IFR/IFD/IFC dates per deliverable

tasks.name: Assess candidate sites for civil constraints
tasks.description: Screens candidate sites for topography, flood risk, soil conditions, access, existing underground and earthworks cost drivers.

consumes.use: historic soil data, climatic and seismic data, survey control and site access rules per candidate site
existing facilities, underground and utilities on or next to each candidate site
unit blocks and capacities to judge footprint
block footprints, rack corridor, tank farm and approximate area per option
flood/wind exposure, separation to receptors and emergency access per site
wetland, habitat and receiving-water constraints affecting earthworks and drainage

tasks.name: Prepare civil and structural design basis
tasks.description: Sets the codes, site environmental loads, load combinations, materials and design criteria for all civil, structural, building and HVAC design.

consumes.use: owner civil/structural standards and order of precedence
design life, winterisation and environmental limits
climatic design data, seismic zone, survey control and coordinate system
ambient design conditions and design cases to align civil environmental data
design blast and fire load method, codes and regulations
fireproofing criteria (API 2218) for structural design criteria

tasks.name: Specify and manage the topographic survey
tasks.description: Scopes the topographic and existing-utilities survey, sets the plant coordinate grid and benchmarks and checks the survey contractor's deliverables.

consumes.use: existing survey control and benchmarks
as-built drawings of existing underground services and facilities
plot limits, battery limits and tie-in areas to survey

tasks.name: Specify the geotechnical investigation
tasks.description: Defines borehole and CPT locations, depths, in-situ and laboratory tests and the geotechnical contractor scope.

consumes.use: locations of heavy equipment, columns, tanks and rack corridors for borehole placement
approximate empty/operating weights of columns, tanks and heavy equipment
per-tag weight estimates to set borehole depths
plant grid and ground levels for borehole coordinates

tasks.name: Set foundation design parameters from the geotechnical report
tasks.description: Reviews the geotechnical report and sets design soil parameters and foundation type by plant area.

consumes.use: planned borehole/CPT locations and tests to check coverage of the report
Geotechnical factual and interpretive report (soil profiles, bearing and pile capacities, settlement, groundwater, soil chemistry) from the geotechnical contractor; no VEND item exists

tasks.name: Prepare civil and structural quantities for estimates
tasks.description: Builds factored and then take-off quantities for earthworks, piling, concrete, rebar, steel, paving and buildings for each estimate class and the control estimate.

consumes.use: equipment, rack, road and building areas for take-off
rack routes, widths, bay spacing and tiers for steel and foundation quantities
FEL1 rack length per option
FEL1 equipment sizes and rough empty weights
per-tag weights for foundation quantities
equipment footprints for foundation sizes
foundation type (shallow/piled) by area
rack and structure steel tonnage per area
estimate class, quantity template, code of accounts and due date
WBS, area and cost codes for quantity breakdown

tasks.name: Review plot plan for civil constraints
tasks.description: Reviews plot plan revisions for grading falls, drainage, road access, crane access, foundation clashes and building locations and returns comments.

consumes.use: equipment, rack, building, road and tank locations per revision
FEL1 block arrangement options
overpressure contours, recommended spacing and building locations
building acceptability and relocation decisions
flood level and rainfall for drainage fall comments
existing ground levels and existing features

tasks.name: Size pipe racks and process structures conceptually
tasks.description: Sets rack widths, bent spacing, tier elevations and structure frames and estimates steel tonnage and load allowances.

consumes.use: rack routes, widths, bay spacing, tier elevations, line allocation and future space
uniform pipe load per tier and concentrated anchor/guide loads
structure placeholders and platform levels in the layout model
cable tray widths and rack levels reserved
instrument tray segments, cable weight and segregation on rack
air cooler bays, plot area and fans to place on rack
air cooler structure and weights
rack load allowances, deflection limits and load combinations

tasks.name: Design site preparation and earthworks
tasks.description: Designs clearing, demolition, cut and fill, soil improvement and temporary drainage for the site.

consumes.use: existing ground levels for cut/fill
soil parameters for compaction and soil improvement
laydown areas, temporary buildings and haul roads to grade
temporary building locations and loads
existing facilities within the plot to demolish or relocate

tasks.name: Prepare grading plan and finished elevations
tasks.description: Sets high point of finished grade, paving areas, curbs and area falls and issues finished elevations to layout and piping.

consumes.use: equipment, paving and road layout
foundation top/grade elevation needs per equipment tag
minimum elevations for NPSHa, thermosiphon and gravity drains
curbed and contained areas, containment volumes, dike and curb locations
existing ground levels
rainfall intensity and flood level for falls and HPFG

tasks.name: Design surface drainage and sewers
tasks.description: Classifies drainage areas and sizes storm, oily water and accidentally contaminated sewers, catch basins, seals and manholes.

consumes.use: effluent and drain flows, composition and frequency per source
drain connections to oily water and closed drain systems on IFD P&IDs
firewater design flows and duration for runoff sizing
outfall data, pretreatment limits and monitoring points
contaminated firewater runoff containment and oil/water separator basis
drain hub, funnel and sump locations in the routed model
underground line routes, inverts, catch basins and tie points
finished grades and area falls
rainfall intensity-duration-frequency

tasks.name: Design tank dikes and containment
tasks.description: Sizes bunds and dikes for tank and equipment containment, intermediate walls, impounding basins and dike drains.

consumes.use: tank diameters, heights and capacities
required containment volumes (110% plus rainfall), dike locations, remote impounding
foam and fixed fire protection coverage for diked areas
tank farm layout
pipe penetrations and sleeves through dike walls

tasks.name: Design roads, access and fencing
tasks.description: Designs plant roads, emergency and maintenance access, crane pads, fencing and gates.

consumes.use: roads, equipment and maintenance areas on the plot plan
bundle pull, removal space and crane access per tag
escape routes, muster points and emergency access
hydrant and monitor locations to keep accessible by fire vehicles
crane positions, crane pad loads and lift sequence
haul roads and construction gates
crane pad bearing and keep-clear zones
security and fencing standards

tasks.name: Coordinate underground services and prepare composite
tasks.description: Combines sewers, firewater mains, underground piping, duct banks, grounding grid and foundations in one composite and resolves conflicts.

consumes.use: ring main routing basis, hydrant and monitor locations, isolation valve sectioning
underground piping routes, sizes, inverts and cover depths
duct bank routes, sections, manholes and depths
ground grid routing and ground wells
instrument cable routes and junction box locations for underground crossings
anode bed, test station and CP cable routing locations
sewer routes and inverts
foundation outlines and depths
pile locations

tasks.name: Design static equipment foundations
tasks.description: Designs foundations for columns, vessels, exchangers, air cooler supports and heaters from vendor loads.

consumes.use: empty/operating/test weights, wind and seismic shear and moment, bundle pull force, anchor bolt circle
skirt/saddle design, wind and seismic moments, hydrotest weights
anchor bolt layout, base ring/saddle dimensions, static loads
certified foundation loads and anchor bolt sizes and pattern
equipment coordinates, orientation and foundation top elevation
pipe support loads landing on equipment foundations
bearing pressure, subgrade modulus and pile capacities
load combinations and stability criteria

tasks.name: Design rotating equipment foundations with dynamic analysis
tasks.description: Designs pump, compressor and blower foundations and checks natural frequency and vibration amplitude.

consumes.use: machine and rotor weights, unbalanced forces, baseplate and anchor bolt layout
certified dynamic data and grouting requirements
pump type, driver and baseplate requirements
compressor/blower type, speeds and foundation requirements
dynamic loads (unbalanced forces, operating frequencies)
dynamic soil properties

tasks.name: Design tank foundations
tasks.description: Designs ringwall or slab tank foundations and predicts settlement for hydrotest and operation.

consumes.use: shell and bottom loads, hydrotest load, overturning, anchorage, allowable settlement
tank diameter, height, roof type and annular plate
tank vendor anchor and shell loads
settlement predictions and bearing capacity

tasks.name: Design piles and prepare piling layout
tasks.description: Selects pile type, designs pile groups and issues the piling layout and test pile programme.

consumes.use: static equipment foundation loads
rotating equipment foundation loads
tank foundation loads
rack column base reactions
structure base reactions
pile axial and lateral capacities
area sequence for piling and early works
CWP start dates for early piling package

tasks.name: Prepare foundation plans and anchor bolt layouts
tasks.description: Issues foundation location plans, foundation details, anchor bolt setting plans and embedment details for construction.

consumes.use: footing and pedestal sizes, reinforcement
block sizes and anchor bolt details
ringwall dimensions
finished grade and top-of-concrete reference
embedments, sleeves and stub-ups to show on foundation drawings
certified anchor bolt templates and baseplate drawings
certified anchor bolt sizes and pattern
equipment coordinates and elevations
pipe support foundation locations and types
ground grid routing and grounding connections at foundations

tasks.name: Analyse and design pipe racks
tasks.description: Analyses rack frames for pipe, cable, air cooler, wind and seismic loads and sizes members and bracing (in the structural analysis program).

consumes.use: pipe weights per tier and future allowance
CAESAR II anchor, guide and friction loads per support tag
tray loads per rack level (kg/m) and support locations
instrument cable weight per tray segment
air cooler weights, structure and support locations
air cooler operating weights and dynamic loads
rack configuration
load allowances
load combinations and deflection limits

tasks.name: Analyse and design process structures and platforms
tasks.description: Designs equipment structures, shelters, platforms, stairs and ladders including vessel-mounted platforms coordination.

consumes.use: structure layouts and access levels
platform and ladder locations for valve and instrument access
pipe support loads on structures
equipment weights on structures
platform clip, davit and ladder positions on vessels
tray loads on structures
electrical equipment weights and anchorage on structures
overpressure contours for open structures
escape route requirements
load combinations and drift limits

tasks.name: Model structures in Tekla and share reference models
tasks.description: Builds the steel and concrete model in Tekla and exports reference models to S3D and to iConstruct through Navisworks.

consumes.use: rack member sizes and geometry
structure member sizes and geometry
foundation geometry for concrete modelling
S3D routed piping and equipment as reference model for clash checks
pipe support model for steel attachment points
secondary steel, stub columns, dummy legs and attachment points with loads

tasks.name: Prepare steel GA drawings and connection design data
tasks.description: Issues steel GA and erection drawings and connection design criteria for the fabricator.

consumes.use: members, marks and connections for GA and erection drawings
rack connection forces
structure connection forces

tasks.name: Prepare structural steel MTO
tasks.description: Extracts steel quantities by profile, grade and coating from Tekla for purchasing and fabrication packages.

consumes.use: member profiles, grades, coatings, lengths and weights

tasks.name: Coordinate embedments, sleeves and penetrations
tasks.description: Collects and schedules embedded plates, sleeves, conduit stub-ups, floor openings and wall penetrations requested by other disciplines.

consumes.use: conduit stub-ups and embeds for transformers, switchgear and E-houses
grounding embeds and pigtails in foundations
conduit drops and cable trench locations
instrument and JB locations needing conduit stub-ups
cable entries in control and rack rooms
sleeves and wall openings with sizes, trench and culvert crossings
embedded plates and support attachment points
firewater line penetrations
deluge valve locations needing pits or housings

tasks.name: Define structural fireproofing extent
tasks.description: Identifies structural members and supports needing fireproofing within fire scenario envelopes and specifies rating and type.

consumes.use: fire-scenario envelopes in plan and elevation
members, skirts and supports needing fireproofing, rating hours and test standard
skirt and saddle geometry for fireproofing extent
member list within fire envelopes

tasks.name: Develop building space programme and layouts
tasks.description: Develops layouts for the control room, substations, rack rooms, analyzer shelters and other buildings with room sizes and openings.

consumes.use: substation footprint, equipment arrangement, cable vault, clearances, doors, transformer pads
substation room layouts
stick-built vs E-house decision
cabinet and console count and footprint, cable entry, floor loading
owner building standards
control room integration and operator interface requirements
building acceptability and occupancy restrictions
Building room programme: staffing, occupancy numbers and required rooms (offices, lab, welfare) for the control building

tasks.name: Design blast-resistant and other buildings structurally
tasks.description: Designs building structures for blast, wind and seismic loads and selects pre-engineered or blast-resistant module options.

consumes.use: side-on and reflected overpressure, impulse and duration per building
required hardening per building
floor loads and equipment weights, blast rating
certified switchgear and transformer weights
building layouts
design criteria

tasks.name: Prepare architectural drawings
tasks.description: Issues building plans, elevations, sections, finishes, door and window schedules and fire ratings.

consumes.use: room layouts
wall/roof construction and blast doors
fixture and receptacle locations in buildings
fixed fire suppression and detection per building
escape routes and exits
lightning protection on buildings and structures

tasks.name: Design building HVAC
tasks.description: Calculates heat loads and sizes HVAC, pressurisation and smoke/gas protection for control buildings and substations.

consumes.use: heat dissipation per room, battery room ventilation, pressurisation needs
cabinet heat dissipation (kW) per room
analyzer shelter HVAC requirements
classified area boundaries around buildings and air intakes
Class/Division, gas group and T-code for HVAC equipment
H2S/flammable detectors at intakes, damper closure times, building tightness
HVAC trip executive actions per F&G zone
HVAC ambient design temperatures
room layouts and volumes

tasks.name: Prepare civil and structural requisitions and bid evaluations
tasks.description: Prepares technical scopes and evaluates bids for piling, civil works, steel fabrication, buildings and HVAC.

consumes.use: commercial terms, instructions to bidders, VDRL
approved bidders per MR
bid questions and answers issued
unpriced technical offers for evaluation
compliance, datasheets, fabricator capacity and piling method
clarification responses
steel tonnage by profile and grade for fabrication requisition
HVAC datasheets
pile quantities and types
geotechnical contractor scope

tasks.name: Review vendor and fabricator drawings
tasks.description: Reviews equipment vendor load and anchor data, steel shop drawings, building and HVAC vendor drawings and returns comments.

consumes.use: dimensions, weights, terminal points
anchor bolt layout and loads to check against foundation design
certified GA and foundation data
steel shop drawings, piece marks and erection drawings
vendor documents routed for civil review with return date

tasks.name: Take part in 3D model reviews and clash resolution
tasks.description: Reviews the combined S3D and Tekla model at 30/60/90 percent reviews and resolves structural clashes and access issues.

consumes.use: Navisworks review model and checklists
clashes involving steel and foundations
model review actions assigned to civil
constructability comments on steel, foundations and access
access and maintenance comments with civil actions

tasks.name: Provide civil inputs to construction packaging
tasks.description: Defines civil and steel CWP boundaries, pour and erection sequence and early works priority with construction.

consumes.use: area sequence from underground to steel
CWA boundaries
heavy lift plan affecting steel leave-outs and erection sequence
CWP IDs and boundaries
early-works and milestone dates
planned IFC dates for civil deliverables

tasks.name: Check, seal and issue civil and structural IFC packages
tasks.description: Checks and PE-seals foundation, steel, underground, building and HVAC drawings and issues IFC packages.

consumes.use: underground composite for check
foundation plans for check
anchor bolt layouts for check
pile layout for check
steel GA drawings for check
fireproofing schedule for check
architectural drawings for check
deliverables to issue IFC and current revisions
planned IFC dates

tasks.name: Answer RFIs and disposition field changes and NCRs
tasks.description: Answers civil and structural RFIs, approves field changes and dispositions concrete, piling and steel non-conformances.

consumes.use: RFI question, location and marked-up extract
proposed field change and affected drawings
as-built foundation elevations and anchor bolt deviations
pile records and concrete test results in the quality dossier
fabricator non-conformances from shop inspection

tasks.name: Evaluate settlement monitoring during hydrotest
tasks.description: Evaluates foundation and tank settlement readings during hydrotest and confirms acceptance.

consumes.use: allowable differential and edge settlement
hydrotest pressures and test hold points
Settlement monitoring survey readings at tank/foundation monitoring points during hydrotest filling and holding

tasks.name: Incorporate as-built civil and structural changes
tasks.description: Updates civil drawings and the Tekla model from field redlines and survey for handover.

consumes.use: redlined foundation, underground and layout drawings
as-built foundation elevations and anchor bolt positions
approved RFI and field change revisions
non-conformance repairs affecting as-built

items.name: Site civil screening assessment
items.content: Per candidate site: topography, flood elevation, likely soil type and foundation type (shallow or piled), access routes, demolition and relocation needs, relative earthworks and foundation cost.

items.name: Structural design criteria
items.content: Design codes, load cases and combinations, deflection and drift limits, steel and concrete grades, pipe rack load allowances, vibration criteria, fireproofing and corrosion protection rules.

items.name: Site environmental design data
items.content: Basic wind speed and exposure, seismic parameters, snow and ice, rainfall intensity-duration-frequency, frost depth, ambient design temperatures for HVAC, flood level.

items.name: Topographic survey and plant grid
items.content: Existing ground levels, plant coordinate system and benchmarks, existing roads, buildings, overhead lines and located underground services.

items.name: Geotechnical investigation scope and borehole plan
items.content: Borehole/CPT locations and depths, test schedule, groundwater monitoring, contractor technical scope for the requisition.

items.name: Foundation design parameters
items.content: Allowable bearing pressure, subgrade modulus, pile axial and lateral capacities, dynamic soil properties, predicted settlement, groundwater level, concrete exposure class.

items.name: Foundation type recommendation by area
items.content: Shallow, piled or improved-ground foundation choice per area and per heavy item, with pile type and soil improvement needs.

items.name: Civil and structural estimate quantities
items.content: By area and WBS: earthworks m3, piles no./m, concrete m3, rebar t, structural steel t by weight class, paving m2, roads m2, sewers m, building areas m2, with growth allowance.

items.name: Civil comments on plot plan
items.content: Marked-up plot plan: required road widths and turning radii, drainage fall directions, dike footprints, building positions, foundation interference and crane access.

items.name: Preliminary pipe rack and structure configuration
items.content: Rack widths, bent spacing, tier elevations, bracing bays, structure frame sizes and steel tonnage per area.

items.name: Pipe rack design load allowances
items.content: Uniform piping load per tier (kN/m2), cable tray loads, concentrated anchor and guide load limits, future-space allowance, air cooler loads assumed; basis for PIPE stress to respect.

items.name: Site preparation and earthworks drawings
items.content: Clearing and demolition limits, cut/fill volumes and limits, soil improvement extent, compaction specification, temporary drainage.

items.name: Grading plan and finished grade elevations
items.content: High point finished grade per area, paving and curb elevations, slopes, top-of-concrete reference elevation used by piping for equipment and support elevations.

items.name: Paving and curbing layout
items.content: Paved areas, curbed areas, curb heights, slab types and joints, unpaved gravel areas.

items.name: Drainage area plan and sewer layout
items.content: Drainage area classification, storm and oily water sewer routes, pipe sizes, invert elevations, catch basins, manholes, vapour seals and sumps.

items.name: Stormwater runoff and discharge data
items.content: Runoff volumes and peak flows per catchment, first-flush volumes, contaminated water volumes to treatment, discharge points, for permitting and effluent treatment sizing.

items.name: Dike and containment design
items.content: Dike heights, capacities, wall types, intermediate walls, penetrations, drain valves and impounding basin sizes.

items.name: Roads, access and fencing layout
items.content: Road widths, pavement build-up, turning radii, crane pads and bearing capacity, gates, fencing lines, kerb and road crossings over underground.

items.name: Underground composite drawing
items.content: All underground services with depths and crossings: sewers, firewater, underground piping, duct banks, grounding, foundations and piles.

items.name: Underground conflict list
items.content: Each crossing or clash, disciplines involved, required depth or route change and resolution status.

items.name: Static equipment foundation calculations
items.content: Per foundation: load cases, footing/pile cap size, pedestal size, anchor bolt check, bearing and stability checks, reinforcement.

items.name: Rotating equipment foundation calculations
items.content: Block size, mass ratio, natural frequencies, predicted amplitudes, anchor bolt and grout details.

items.name: Dynamic analysis results for vendor review
items.content: Foundation stiffness and frequency results sent to the machine vendor and mechanical for acceptance.

items.name: Tank foundation design
items.content: Ringwall dimensions, pad build-up, leak detection, predicted and allowable settlement, settlement monitoring points.

items.name: Pile layout and schedule
items.content: Pile coordinates, cut-off levels, pile type, lengths, design capacities per pile group; early piling package for procurement.

items.name: Test pile programme
items.content: Test pile locations, load test types and acceptance criteria.

items.name: Foundation plans and details
items.content: Foundation coordinates, top of concrete and grout elevations, dimensions, reinforcement, concrete grade, construction joints.

items.name: Anchor bolt layouts and schedule
items.content: Anchor bolt coordinates, size, length, projection, material, sleeve and template details per foundation for procurement and setting.

items.name: Pipe rack design calculations and reactions
items.content: Member sizes, connection forces, column base reactions per bent for foundation design, utilisation and deflection checks.

items.name: Process structure design calculations and reactions
items.content: Member sizes, platform loads, connection forces and base reactions for foundation design.

items.name: Tekla structural model
items.content: Steel members, connections, plates, grating, stairs, ladders and concrete foundations with fabrication attributes.

items.name: Structural reference model for S3D
items.content: Periodic export of steel and concrete geometry to S3D as a reference model for piping and layout clash checks.

items.name: Structural model for iConstruct
items.content: Tekla model published to Navisworks/iConstruct with CWP and erection sequence attributes for AWP.

items.name: Steel GA and erection drawings
items.content: Plans, elevations, member marks and sizes, platform layouts, erection marks and sequence notes.

items.name: Connection design forces and criteria
items.content: Connection forces per member end, connection types and bolting criteria for fabricator-designed connections.

items.name: Structural steel MTO
items.content: Tonnage and lengths by profile, grade, coating and fireproofing, grating m2, bolts, per area and CWP; exported from Tekla for re-keying into Purchasing DB.

items.name: Embedment and sleeve schedule
items.content: Each embedded item and penetration: requesting discipline, location, size, elevation, type and drawing reference.

items.name: Structural fireproofing schedule
items.content: Members, skirts, supports and rack levels to be fireproofed, rating, type (concrete, cementitious, intumescent), quantities.

items.name: Building layouts for electrical and I&C
items.content: Room layouts and dimensions, equipment areas, false floor and cable cellar, cable entry walls, door sizes, floor openings and trench locations.

items.name: Building structural design
items.content: Blast design response, wall/roof construction, blast doors, foundation reactions, floor load capacities.

items.name: Architectural drawings
items.content: Plans, elevations, finishes, door and window schedules, fire ratings, ceilings, plumbing fixtures.

items.name: HVAC heat load calculations and equipment sizing
items.content: Room heat loads, design conditions, air changes, pressurisation, AHU/package unit capacities and redundancy.

items.name: HVAC electrical loads
items.content: Each HVAC consumer: tag, kW, voltage, duty/standby, essential/UPS supply need, for the electrical load list.

items.name: HVAC control and shutdown interface
items.content: Gas detector at air intakes, damper closure, HVAC trip and alarm signals to F&G/DCS, HVAC control panel I/O.

items.name: HVAC datasheets and requisition scope
items.content: HVAC unit datasheets, duct and damper specifications, scope for HVAC package requisition.

items.name: Civil and structural requisitions and TBEs
items.content: Material requisitions and technical scopes, technical bid evaluations and acceptability recommendations.

items.name: Civil vendor data review comments
items.content: Commented vendor documents with status codes: anchor bolt confirmation, load acceptance, shop drawing corrections.

items.name: Civil model review responses and clash resolutions
items.content: Each structural or civil clash or comment, resolution and model change status.

items.name: Civil and structural CWP scope and sequence
items.content: Civil/steel CWP list, deliverables per CWP, foundation pour sequence, steel erection sequence and release dates.

items.name: Sealed IFC civil and structural package
items.content: IFC issue of civil, structural, architectural and HVAC drawings with PE seal and transmittal.

items.name: Civil RFI responses and field change dispositions
items.content: Answer, sketch and any drawing revision for each RFI and field change.

items.name: Civil non-conformance dispositions
items.content: Accept, repair or reject disposition for concrete strength, anchor bolt misplacement, pile capacity and steel fit-up NCRs.

items.name: Settlement evaluation and acceptance
items.content: Measured vs predicted settlement, acceptance or hold on filling, remedial actions.

items.name: As-built civil and structural drawings and model
items.content: As-built foundation, underground, steel and building drawings and updated Tekla model for owner handover.

items.name: Civil deliverables list
items.content: Foundation, steel, building and site drawings with planned dates.

items.name: Civil progress measurement
items.content: Foundation and steel drawing completion counts against plan.

items.name: Civil holds
items.content: Foundation drawings on hold awaiting certified vendor loads, with cause.

items.name: Geotechnical and soil corrosivity report
items.content: Geotechnical contractor's factual and interpretive report: soil profiles, bearing and pile capacities, settlement, groundwater, soil resistivity (Wenner) and chemistry (pH, chlorides).
